scope: Public, non-mutating HATCH/MPOLYGON boundary point and vector coordinate mapping from OCS to WCS; does not transform parser callbacks, alter stored boundary geometry, or qualify native hatch semantics

authority.title: Autodesk HATCH (DXF)
rules: HATCH and MPOLYGON group 10 is an OCS elevation point; X and Y are zero and Z is the elevation.
Group 210/220/230 supplies the WCS extrusion direction.

authority.title: Autodesk Boundary Path Data (DXF)
rules: Polyline, line, circular-arc, elliptical-arc, and spline boundary points use OCS coordinates.
Spline boundary start and end tangents are OCS vectors.

authority.title: Autodesk Object Coordinate Systems (DXF)
authority.rule: The entity extrusion direction defines the OCS basis using the arbitrary-axis algorithm.

behavior: DRW_Hatch::boundaryPointToWcs adds the HATCH OCS elevation and maps the complete point through the shared arbitrary-axis basis.
DRW_Hatch::boundaryVectorToWcs maps vectors without applying elevation translation.
DRW_MPolygon inherits both mappings from DRW_Hatch.
The methods do not mutate the input, extrusion normal, elevation, or stored 2D boundary model; no data members or virtual methods were added.
Existing DRW_Entity::calculateAxis now uses the same basis calculation, keeping the mapper and existing applyExtrusion conversions aligned.

cases: normal [1,0,0], vector [2,3,0] maps to [0,2,3] without translation
non-unit MPOLYGON normal [2,0,0] produces the normalized OCS basis
negative WCS Z normal [0,0,-1] maps point [2,3,0] at elevation 4 to [-2,3,-4]
input coordinates and stored HATCH elevation/normal remain unchanged
control.fixtureDisposition: No drawing fixture was created or committed.

limitations: This is a coordinate mapping API only. dxfRW does not automatically rewrite HATCH/MPOLYGON callback coordinates when applyExtrusion is true.
No physical producer, LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD, or other native consumer was exercised.
Boundary evaluation, fill/rendering meaning, associated source objects, writer round-trip and other HATCH/MPOLYGON profiles remain unqualified.
